title: Envelope
description: Every message crossing a component boundary: a CloudEvents 1.0 structured-mode JSON document with Autonomy extension attributes, signed by the sender. Receivers ignore unknown extension attributes.

propertyNames.description: CloudEvents attribute names: lowercase letters and digits only. Excludes data_base64 (binary data is not used in v0).

time.description: Required in Autonomy (optional in CloudEvents) for skew checks.

data.description: Any JSON value. When dataschema names a spec schema, data must validate against it.

seq.description: Monotonic per sender, survives restarts; used for dedup and ordering.

expires.description: Receiver rejects after this time. Required by receivers for commands.

causationid.description: id of the envelope that caused this one.

principal.description: Identity on whose behalf this is sent; usually equal to source.

autonomysig.description: Signature over the canonical JSON of the envelope without autonomysig.
